info.cls_name: 文物管理與鑑識學分學程

description.describe_ch: 本課程以歷史學為主，參考建築學、人類學等相關學門論著，介紹臺灣特定古蹟。課程將結合影像、史蹟田野考察與課堂講述等不同方式進行，藉此呈現人與古蹟、鄉土與世界，彼此間的複雜關係，使學生能在欣賞古蹟之餘，也對臺灣的過去能有深刻的體認。課程內容將以具體案例介紹為引，講述古蹟背後的歷史故事，作為認識不同主題的入門。案例的選擇，除特殊主題外，將以臺中市為中心，視主題需要向全島擴增，至於主題主要涵蓋大航海時代與臺灣；漢人在臺土地拓墾事業；漢人移民信仰；晚清臺灣外貿發展；晚清臺灣涉外事件；臺灣水利設施與水田化；臺灣經濟作物栽培；西洋宗教在臺傳播；臺灣教育變遷；臺灣交通變遷等主題。
description.describe_eh: This course introduces specific monuments in Taiwan with a focus on history and references to architecture, anthropology, and other related fields. The course combines photography, historical fieldwork and classroom lectures to present the complex relationship between people and monuments and between the homeland and the world, so that students can appreciate monuments and gain a deep understanding of Taiwan's past. The course aims to introduce the historical stories behind the monuments with specific case studies as an introduction to different themes. The selection of cases is centered on Taichung city and expanded to the whole island as needed of topics. The topics mainly covers the Great Age of Navigation and Taiwan; Chinese land reclamation in Taiwan; Chinese immigrants' beliefs; Taiwan’s foreign trade development in the late Qing Dynasty; Taiwan’s foreign-related events in the late Qing Dynasty; Taiwan’s water conservation facilities and paddy fields; Taiwan’s economic crop cultivation; Western religions in Taiwan; Taiwan’s educational changes; Taiwan’s transportation changes, etc.

targets.describe_ch: 使學生體認古蹟與人的關係，進而能對古蹟維護價值有所認識。
targets.describe_en: To appreciate the relationship between monuments and people, and the understanding of the value of monument maintenance

targets.describe_ch: 使學生能了解台灣歷史發展與外部世界的關聯，從而反思對台灣在世界史上的角色與定位。
targets.describe_en: To understand the relationship between the historical development of Taiwan and the outside world, and thus reflect on the role of Taiwan in world history

targets.describe_ch: 使學生瞭解並欣賞古蹟建築與藝術價值。
targets.describe_en: To understand and appreciate the architectural and artistic value of monuments
